description: This Java class 'TransmissionManagerImpl' implements transmission management functionalities for ECU communication, including starting, sending queries, ending, and stopping transmission processes. It primarily manages logging and configuration interactions related to ECU data transmission.

classes.name: TransmissionManagerImpl
classes.description: Implementation of the TransmissionManager interface responsible for managing ECU data transmission and logging operations within the software.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Starts the transmission manager, performing initial setup and logging the start event.

methods.name: sendQueries
methods.description: Sends a collection of ECU queries through the transmission interface and logs the operation.

methods.name: endQueries
methods.description: Ends the ongoing ECU query transmission session, cleaning up the interface.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops the transmission manager, finalizing the operations and logging the shutdown event.
